title: CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design sp

translated_title: CocoRNA：基于协作多智能体强化学习的集体RNA设计
translated_abstract: 设计能够可靠折叠成特定二级结构的RNA序列对于理解其生物功能至关重要，但这仍然是一个具有挑战性的计算问题。我们提出了CocoRNA，一个用于RNA逆向设计的协作多智能体强化学习框架。CocoRNA通过将设计任务分解为更小的子问题来简化设计任务，每个子问题由多个智能体协作解决。这种方法降低了问题的复杂性，并改善了设计策略的探索。在训练过程中，集中式评论家利用全局结构信息来指导智能体，使它们能够联合优化各自的设计策略。因此，CocoRNA学习到了高质量的RNA设计策略，无需额外训练即可有效泛化到未见过的结构。在Rfam数据集上的实验表明，CocoRNA在成功率和设计效率方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
tldr: CocoRNA是一个协作多智能体强化学习框架，通过将RNA逆向设计分解为多个子问题并由多个智能体协作求解，在成功率和设计效率上显著超越现有最先进方法，且无需额外训练即可泛化到未见结构。
en_tdlr: CocoRNA is a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that decomposes RNA inverse design into smaller sub-problems solved collaboratively by multiple agents, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design efficiency while generalizing to unseen structures without additional training.
